第23章 丹火塔包圆聚灵丹（第1页）
骤然抬手。恐怖灵力瞬间汇聚于掌间。
这时，远处传来一道清冷喝止之音。
几人循声望去，只见沐倾城缓缓走来。
守门两人顿时愣住了，心里直犯嘀咕。
叶凡逾期方至，竟同时惊动了陈离、沐倾城？
几步路后，沐倾城停下脚步，告知守门二人道，“叶凡若是回来，入第一院！”
守门两人面面相觑，一时有些无措。
三皇子段天涯，没权力给叶凡特权。
但身为第一院院长的紫苑，有这权力！
他们只是怀疑，沐倾城会不会是在传假令？
沐倾城看出两人的疑虑，取出一块令牌。
叶瑶瞪了叶凡一眼，可不觉得这是好事。
尤其是陈离的出现，反而让她感到不安。
沐倾城走上前来，冲叶凡温柔一笑，跟着对叶瑶道，“叶瑶，你带叶凡安排一下入学事宜。”
叶瑶瞪了沐倾城一眼，似有些不快。
大家都是内院学员，谁也没比谁高一等。

沐倾城嘴角含笑，没有与叶瑶争辩，只是朝叶凡点了点头，随后转身从容离去。
叶瑶盯着沐倾城离去的背影，撇了撇嘴，好像有点酸。
“瑶姐，你这么大火气干嘛？人家也没招你惹你啊？”
叶凡忍不住调侃道，“你看看人家，多大气。咱们别那么小气行不行？”
叶瑶被叶凡说得一噎，抬手就要敲他的脑袋。
陈离冷声响起，打断了正打闹的两人。
两人扭头，只见陈离阴冷地盯着他们。
叶瑶拽起叶凡的胳膊，大大咧咧地招呼道，“走，我带你好好逛逛天武书院。”
整个外院区域，占天武书院六成之地。
叶瑶带着叶凡四处闲逛，大致介绍了外院各处重要场所，之后将叶凡带到了一片住宅区前。
首先引入眼帘的，是一块高耸石碑。
石碑后方这片区域，则是规模不一的住宅。

Suddenly he raised his hand. The terrifying spiritual power instantly gathered in the palm of his hand.
At this time, a cold voice came from the distance.
Several people followed the sound and saw Mu Qingcheng walking slowly.
The two gatekeepers were stunned immediately, muttering in their hearts.
Ye Fan arrived after the deadline, but he alarmed Chen Li and Mu Qingcheng at the same time?
After a few steps, Mu Qingcheng stopped and told the two gatekeepers, "If Ye Fan comes back, enter the first hospital!"
The two gatekeepers looked at each other, a little at a loss for a moment.
The third prince, Duan Tianya, had no right to give Ye Fan special privileges.
But as the dean of the First Academy, Ziyuan has this power!
They just wondered if Mu Qingcheng was passing on false orders?
Mu Qingcheng saw the two people's doubts and took out a token.
Ye Yao glared at Ye Fan, but she didn't think this was a good thing.
Especially the appearance of Chen Li made her feel uneasy.
Mu Qingcheng stepped forward, smiled tenderly at Ye Fan, and then said to Ye Yao, "Ye Yao, please take Ye Fan to make arrangements for admission."
Ye Yao glared at Mu Qingcheng, seeming a little unhappy.
Everyone is a student in the inner courtyard, and no one is superior to anyone else.
Mu Qingcheng smiled and did not argue with Ye Yao. She just nodded to Ye Fan, then turned around and left calmly.
Ye Yao stared at Mu Qingcheng's leaving figure and curled her lips, as if she was a little sore.
"Sister Yao, why are you so angry? I didn't ask anyone to mess with you?"
Ye Fan couldn't help but joked, "Look at how grand this person is. Can we not be so stingy?"
Ye Yao was choked by Ye Fan's words and raised her hand to hit him on the head.
Chen Li's cold voice interrupted the two people who were fighting.
The two turned their heads and saw Chen Li staring at them coldly.
Ye Yao grabbed Ye Fan's arm and greeted him carelessly, "Let's go, I'll take you to have a good tour of Tianwu Academy."
The entire outer courtyard area occupies 60% of Tianwu Academy.
Ye Yao took Ye Fan around, briefly introduced the important places in the outer courtyard, and then brought Ye Fan to a residential area.
The first thing that catches the eye is a towering stone monument.
The area behind the stone monument is filled with residences of varying sizes.
